title: Does every simple first-order theory have stable forking
exact_target: Must forking in a simple theory always be witnessed by a stable formula? The cited paper claims a negative answer to this historical question.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7600009 (AMR-075-0009). CC BY 4.0.
James Freitag and Scott Mutchnik, A Counterexample to the Stable Forking Conjecture, arXiv:2609.00436v1 (31 August 2026), Definitions 1.1 and Conjecture 1.2, p. 2; Theorem 1.3, p. 3.
